update.title: Update available
update.message: A new version of Vice Tracker is ready, with the latest fixes and features.

cards.notice: New missions daily, wait for it

cards.comingSoonText: Will be available after Launch day ❤️

items.name: Prologue
items.description: A 2004 bank robbery in Ludendorff, North Yankton, goes badly wrong.

items.name: Franklin and Lamar
items.description: Franklin and Lamar repossess two sports cars for Simeon and race them back to the dealership.

items.name: Repossession
items.description: Franklin and Lamar repossess a motorbike for Simeon and have to fight their way out.

items.name: Complications
items.description: Franklin is sent to repossess a car in Rockford Hills and meets its owner, Michael.

items.name: Father/Son
items.description: Michael and Franklin chase down Michael's yacht to get Jimmy back.

items.name: Chop
items.description: A deal with the Ballas turns into an ambush, and Franklin uses Chop to track down a runaway gang member.

items.name: Marriage Counseling
items.description: Michael catches Amanda with her tennis coach and takes revenge on the wrong house.

items.name: Daddy's Little Girl
items.description: A Michael family mission involving his daughter Tracey.

items.name: Friend Request
items.description: Michael helps Lester sabotage the launch of a Lifeinvader phone.

items.name: The Long Stretch
items.description: Franklin backs up Lamar and Stretch at a deal that turns into a shootout.

items.name: The Good Husband
items.description: Optional Michael family mission with Amanda.

items.name: Casing the Jewel Store
items.description: Michael scouts the Vangelico jewelry store's security for the first heist.

items.name: Carbine Rifles
items.description: Heist setup: steal carbine rifles for The Jewel Store Job. Loud approach only.

items.name: BZ Gas Grenades
items.description: Heist setup: steal BZ gas grenades for The Jewel Store Job. Smart approach only.

items.name: Bugstars Equipment
items.description: Heist setup: steal a Bugstars pest-control van. Smart approach only.

items.name: The Jewel Store Job
items.description: Rob the Vangelico jewelry store using the smart or loud approach, then escape.

items.name: Mr. Philips
items.description: Trevor is introduced in Sandy Shores and goes after The Lost MC.

items.name: Trevor Philips Industries
items.description: Trevor starts building his business in Blaine County and takes on a rival gang.

items.name: Nervous Ron
items.description: Trevor and Ron go after The Lost MC's business.

items.name: Crystal Maze
items.description: Trevor attacks the O'Neil brothers' meth operation.

items.name: Friends Reunited
items.description: Trevor arrives in Los Santos and tracks down Michael.

items.name: Fame or Shame
items.description: Michael and Trevor go after Lazlow at a talent show taping.

items.name: Dead Man Walking
items.description: Michael carries out a dangerous favor for FIB agents Dave Norton and Steve Haines.

items.name: Three's Company
items.description: All three protagonists team up for an FIB extraction job.

items.name: By the Book
items.description: Trevor carries out a brutal interrogation for the FIB while Michael hunts the target.

items.name: Hood Safari
items.description: Trevor joins Franklin and Lamar on a drug deal that turns violent.

items.name: Did Somebody Say Yoga?
items.description: Michael's yoga session at home goes strangely wrong.

items.name: Scouting the Port
items.description: Trevor scouts the Los Santos docks for the next heist.

items.name: Minisub
items.description: Heist setup: steal a mini submarine for The Merryweather Heist.

items.name: Cargobob
items.description: Heist setup: steal a Cargobob helicopter for The Merryweather Heist.

items.name: The Merryweather Heist
items.description: Steal a Merryweather weapon shipment using the offshore or freighter approach.

items.name: The Hotel Assassination
items.description: Lester's first contract for Franklin, required for the story.

items.name: Boiler Suits
items.description: Heist setup for Blitz Play: get boiler suits for the crew.

items.name: Masks
items.description: Heist setup for Blitz Play: buy masks for the crew.

items.name: Trash Truck
items.description: Heist setup for Blitz Play: steal a garbage truck.

items.name: Tow Truck
items.description: Heist setup for Blitz Play: steal a tow truck.

items.name: Blitz Play
items.description: The crew ambushes an armored truck in Los Santos for the FIB.

items.name: I Fought the Law...
items.description: The crew steals high-end cars and escapes the police.

items.name: Eye in the Sky
items.description: Franklin and Trevor team up, with Trevor in the air.

items.name: Mr. Richards
items.description: Michael meets film producer Solomon Richards and starts working in the movie business.

items.name: Caida Libre
items.description: Michael and Trevor pull off a high-altitude job that ends in freefall.

items.name: Deep Inside
items.description: Franklin steals a prop car from a film set.

items.name: Minor Turbulence
items.description: Trevor intercepts a cargo plane carrying Merryweather goods.

items.name: Paleto Score Setup
items.description: Michael and Trevor scout the Blaine County Savings Bank in Paleto Bay.

items.name: Predator
items.description: The crew hunts down a target for the FIB, with help from Chop.

items.name: Military Hardware
items.description: Heist setup: steal military equipment for The Paleto Score.

items.name: The Paleto Score
items.description: Rob the Paleto Bay bank in heavy armor and fight your way out.

items.name: Derailed
items.description: Michael and Trevor take on a job involving a train.

items.name: Monkey Business
items.description: The crew steals a chemical agent from Humane Labs.

items.name: Hang Ten
items.description: Michael and Trevor mission after Monkey Business.

items.name: Surveying the Score
items.description: The crew scouts the Union Depository for the Big Score.

items.name: Bury the Hatchet
items.description: Michael and Trevor return to North Yankton and uncover the truth about the 2004 job.

items.name: Pack Man
items.description: Franklin and Trevor steal a truckload of cars for Devin Weston.

items.name: Fresh Meat
items.description: Franklin rescues Michael from the Triads.

items.name: The Ballad of Rocco
items.description: Michael deals with Rocco, who is causing trouble for Solomon's film.

items.name: Cleaning out the Bureau
items.description: Michael goes undercover as a janitor to scout the FIB building.

items.name: Architect's Plans
items.description: Franklin steals the FIB building's blueprints.

items.name: Fire Truck
items.description: Heist setup: steal a fire truck. Fire Crew approach only.

items.name: The Bureau Raid
items.description: Raid the FIB building using the Fire Crew or Roof Entry approach.

items.name: The Wrap Up
items.description: A standoff between rival agencies turns into a firefight.

items.name: Reuniting the Family
items.description: Michael tries to bring his family back together.

items.name: Doting Dad
items.description: Optional Michael family mission.

items.name: Legal Trouble
items.description: Michael chases down someone trying to take Solomon's film.

items.name: Lamar Down
items.description: All three protagonists rescue Lamar from the Ballas.

items.name: Meltdown
items.description: Michael attends the premiere of Solomon's film.

items.name: Parenting 101
items.description: Optional Michael family mission.

items.name: Planning the Big Score
items.description: Plan the Union Depository heist and choose the Subtle or Obvious approach.

items.name: Stingers
items.description: Heist setup for The Big Score. Subtle approach only.

items.name: Gauntlet
items.description: Heist setup: steal three Gauntlet getaway cars. Subtle approach only.

items.name: Sidetracked
items.description: Heist setup for The Big Score. Obvious approach only.

items.name: Driller
items.description: Heist setup: steal a drill for The Big Score. Obvious approach only.

items.name: The Big Score
items.description: Rob the Union Depository's gold reserve.

items.name: Something Sensible
items.description: Ending A. One of three final missions: pick only one.

items.name: The Time's Come
items.description: Ending B. One of three final missions: pick only one.

items.name: The Third Way
items.description: Ending C, widely treated as canon. One of three final missions: pick only one.

items.name: Pulling Favors
items.description: Tow an abandoned car to the LSPD impound for Tonya.

items.name: Pulling Another Favor
items.description: A second impound tow for Tonya.

items.name: Pulling Favors Again
items.description: Tow a stalled car to a repair shop.

items.name: Still Pulling Favors
items.description: Tow a broken-down car to its destination.

items.name: Pulling One Last Favor
items.description: Tonya's final tow job.

items.name: Shift Work
items.description: Win an evening street race against Hao's crew.

items.name: Paparazzo
items.description: Chase a celebrity so Beverly can get his photos.

items.name: Paparazzo - The Sex Tape
items.description: Film a celebrity in secret and escape security.

items.name: Paparazzo - The Partnership
items.description: Beverly proposes a partnership.

items.name: Paparazzo - The Meltdown
items.description: Chase Poppy Mitchell so her arrest can be photographed.

items.name: Paparazzo - The Highness
items.description: Photograph a princess at a drug deal without being seen.

items.name: Paparazzo - Reality Check
items.description: Beverly's final job.

items.name: Grass Roots - Franklin
items.description: Meet Barry, who is campaigning to legalize marijuana.

items.name: Grass Roots - The Pickup
items.description: Deliver a truck to Barry without attracting the police.

items.name: Grass Roots - The Drag
items.description: Tow a stash car to Barry's place.

items.name: Grass Roots - The Smoke-In
items.description: Make a delivery to Barry's smoke-in at City Hall.

items.name: Exercising Demons - Franklin
items.description: Beat Mary-Ann in a triathlon.

items.name: A Starlet in Vinewood
items.description: Confront Peter Dreyfuss. Unlocks after collecting all 50 Letter Scraps.

items.name: Far Out
items.description: Meet Omega, who sends you looking for spaceship parts.

items.name: The Final Frontier
items.description: Return to Omega after collecting all 50 Spaceship Parts.

items.name: Risk Assessment
items.description: Skydive onto Mount Chiliad and race Dom down on bikes.

items.name: Liquidity Risk
items.description: Ride an ATV out of a cargo plane and skydive after Dom.

items.name: Targeted Risk
items.description: Parachute onto a moving flatbed truck.

items.name: Uncalculated Risk
items.description: Dom's final stunt. Unlocks after all 13 parachute jumps.

items.name: The Last One
items.description: Hunt for Bigfoot. Unlocks only at 100% completion.

items.name: Grass Roots - Michael
items.description: Michael tries Barry's product and fights off hallucinated aliens.

items.name: Exercising Demons - Michael
items.description: Beat Mary-Ann in a foot race.

items.name: Seeking the Truth
items.description: First Epsilon mission, after the Epsilon website evaluation.

items.name: Accepting the Truth
items.description: Visit an Epsilon room after a donation.

items.name: Assuming the Truth
items.description: Deliver five vehicles for the Epsilon Program.

items.name: Chasing the Truth
items.description: Search a field for Epsilon artifacts with a scanner.

items.name: Bearing the Truth
items.description: Wear Epsilon robes for ten days.

items.name: Delivering the Truth
items.description: Fly an Epsilon plane to Sandy Shores Airfield.

items.name: Exercising the Truth
items.description: Complete a five-mile desert walk in robes.

items.name: Unknowing the Truth
items.description: The Epsilon Program's final task.

items.name: Death at Sea
items.description: Meet Abigail, who sends you after submarine pieces.

items.name: What Lies Beneath
items.description: Return to Abigail after collecting all 30 Submarine Pieces.

items.name: Grass Roots - Trevor
items.description: Trevor tries Barry's product and fights off hallucinated clowns.

items.name: Exercising Demons - Trevor
items.description: Beat Mary-Ann in a bike race.

items.name: Target Practice
items.description: Prove your shooting skills to Cletus.

items.name: Fair Game
items.description: Go hunting with Cletus.

items.name: The Civil Border Patrol
items.description: Help two self-appointed border patrolmen.

items.name: An American Welcome
items.description: Another job for the border patrolmen.

items.name: Minute Man Blues
items.description: The final border patrol mission.

items.name: Special Bonds
items.description: Meet Maude, who hands out bail bond jobs.

items.name: Mrs. Philips
items.description: Trevor's mother pays a visit.

items.name: Damaged Goods
items.description: Follow-up to Mrs. Philips.

items.name: Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill
items.description: Meet two celebrity-obsessed British tourists.

items.name: Vinewood Souvenirs - Willy
items.description: Get a souvenir from Willy for Nigel.

items.name: Vinewood Souvenirs - Tyler
items.description: Steal Tyler Dixon's clothes without being seen.

items.name: Vinewood Souvenirs - Kerry
items.description: Chase Kerry McIntosh's dog and take its collar.

items.name: Vinewood Souvenirs - Mark
items.description: Get Mark Fostenburg's golf club.

items.name: Vinewood Souvenirs - Al Di Napoli
items.description: Kidnap actor Al Di Napoli for Nigel.

items.name: Vinewood Souvenirs - The Last Act
items.description: The final Vinewood Souvenirs job.

items.name: Extra Commission
items.description: Destroy 15 of a rival realtor's For Sale signs.

items.name: Closing the Deal
items.description: Chase down and beat up the rival realtor.

items.name: Surreal Estate
items.description: Burn down Josh's house for the insurance money.

items.name: Breach of Contract
items.description: Josh betrays Trevor to the police.

items.name: Rampage 1: Rednecks
items.description: Kill 25 rednecks within 2 minutes.

items.name: Rampage 2: Vagos
items.description: Kill 30 Vagos within 2 minutes.

items.name: Rampage 3: Ballas
items.description: Kill 30 Ballas within 2 minutes.

items.name: Rampage 4: Military
items.description: Kill 35 soldiers and destroy tanks within 3 minutes, using a grenade launcher.

items.name: Rampage 5: Hipsters
items.description: Kill 20 hipsters within 2 minutes.

items.name: Bail Bond: Ralph Ostrowski
items.description: Bring in a fugitive hiding at the Davis Quartz quarry. Alive pays more.

items.name: Bail Bond: Larry Tupper
items.description: Bring in a fugitive at a barn near Harmony. Alive pays more.

items.name: Bail Bond: Glenn Scoville
items.description: Bring in a fugitive on Mount Chiliad. Alive pays more.

items.name: Bail Bond: Curtis Weaver
items.description: Bring in a fugitive at a commune east of Paleto Bay. Alive pays more.

items.name: The Multi Target Assassination
items.description: Optional Lester contract with a stock-market tie-in.

items.name: The Vice Assassination
items.description: Optional Lester contract with a stock-market tie-in.

items.name: The Bus Assassination
items.description: Optional Lester contract with a stock-market tie-in.

items.name: The Construction Assassination
items.description: Optional Lester contract with a stock-market tie-in.

items.name: Letter Scraps (50)
items.description: Collect all 50 to piece together a confession, unlock A Starlet in Vinewood and the A Mystery, Solved achievement.

items.name: Spaceship Parts (50)
items.description: Available after Far Out. Collect all 50 for The Final Frontier, the Space Docker vehicle and the From Beyond the Stars achievement.

items.name: Submarine Pieces (30)
items.description: Available after Death at Sea. Collect all 30 for What Lies Beneath.

items.name: Nuclear Waste (30)
items.description: Underwater barrels collected with a submersible after buying the Sonar Collections Dock. Pays per barrel and unlocks Waste Management.

items.name: Epsilon Tracts (10)
items.description: Part of the Epsilon Program missions.

items.name: Stunt Jumps (50)
items.description: Land a clean jump on each ramp. 25 count toward 100%; all 50 unlock Show Off.

items.name: Under the Bridge (50)
items.description: Fly a plane under each bridge. 25 count toward 100%; all 50 plus all Knife Flights unlock Close Shave.

items.name: Knife Flights (15)
items.description: Fly a plane sideways through each narrow gap. 8 count toward 100%.

items.name: Peyote Plants (27)
items.description: Enhanced Edition. Eating one turns you into an animal for a short time.

items.name: Monkey Mosaics (50)
items.description: Enhanced Edition. Photograph all 50 wall mosaics.
